Garage description
Covered with bloody red stains, this paint is meant to inflict horror upon the enemy. However, highly experienced tankers will probably notice that what looks like blood is actually tomato juice. No wonder the paint is called "Mary".
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on July 29, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Mary's price was 6,500 crystals and was obtainable at the rank of Master Sergeant.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that protects against several guns. Offers decent protection against Smoky and Twins while being excellent against Freeze. Good for short to mid-range battles. Gives your tank a garish, memorable look.
